main_measure.name: pooled slope of next-day excess return on forecast, down-day bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2 (and top-quintile mean > 0); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return, top quintile of forecast on down-day bars

decided_by: Confirm rule: the slope is positive with t = 2.86 >= 2 and the top-quintile mean excess return is above 0.
reading: Down day from the 1-bar close return inside each window (raw component sign on a window's first bar); excess = next-day return minus the coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows; slope by pooled OLS with a day-clustered (CR1, G/(G-1)) standard error; top quintile = down-day bars with forecast at or above the pooled 80th percentile; its t is the ordinary t of the mean, as the plan does not name one.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.0002565 on the check folds against +0.0004341 on every fold
